shared_elements: low-relief figures carved on an upright slab/pillar face
animal shown in profile (quadruped in A; small animal/bird signs in B)
figures oriented across the flat face rather than in the round
justification: The only real correspondence is that both surfaces carry shallow relief profile figures on an upright slab, including animal forms in profile, which is a generic feature many traditions share. A shows two isolated, large, sparsely placed quadrupeds with no framing, whereas B is densely organised into horizontal registers of small human figures with offering gestures, dense sign-like script, and a winged disc with paired eyes at the top — an entirely different iconographic scheme.
